skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Design travel programs, analyze target customers, select suppliers and destinations, create itineraries, and calculate prices.
Plan the operation of tours including selecting suppliers, preparing budgets, and evaluating post-tour activities.
Perform guiding duties including pre-trip planning, on-site guiding, and post-trip evaluation.
Communicate effectively with internal company staff, service providers, and customers.
Work collaboratively with team members and other departments within the company.
Identify and solve problems encountered during tour operations.
Maintain a positive attitude and actively participate in environmental and social protection activities.
Demonstrate adaptability and the ability to integrate and update knowledge at travel companies.
